name: Bokeh Dissolve
description: The picture falls out of focus like a camera lens, its highlights swelling into large bright bokeh discs, and the second clip sharpens back out of its own bokeh. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: radius
params.description: Radius of the bokeh discs at the peak, in frame heights

params.name: blades
params.description: Number of aperture blades, which shape the discs into polygons (below 3: round)

params.name: threshold
params.description: Brightness above which a pixel is a highlight that swells into a disc
